messages:
daniel_rm: Heads-up — deploying release v2.14.0 to prod in the 22:00 UTC change window. Planning preflight at 21:30 and canary at 22:00. Need final sign-off on backout script, pin strategy, and who has kill authority.

deploybot: :robot_face: rollout scheduled r-4392 -> prod (services: inference, api-gateway, metrics-proxy). Canary: 2% traffic for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then 100%. Automated healthchecks enabled.

priya.k: Quick checklist — are feature flags for the new routing off in prod by default? If not we need them off during canary. Also confirm smoke tests cover embeddings/regen path.

alice-ng: Flags are off by default. Backout/runbook notes below — please read and ack. TL;DR triggers for backout: latency P50 > 250ms for 3+ min OR errors (5xx) > 2% for 5+ min OR tail latency spikes impacting critical routes.

alice-ng: Runbook link: https://internal.wiki/redwood/deploys/v2.14-backout (please don't edit; read-only for oncall). Quick rollback commands pasted: 
```
# rollback API gateway to pinned stable
redwoodctl releases rollback --service api-gateway --to 2.13.9 --reason "auto-backout: latency spike"
# pin inference to stable to prevent autopromotion
redwoodctl pin set --service inference --version 2.13.9 --until 2026-04-03
```

javier.p: Note on pinning — pin sets are cluster-wide for that service. If we pin inference to 2.13.9 we must ensure metrics-proxy is compatible (it will be). Also: if rollback is triggered we should disable autoscaler temporarily to avoid OOM thrash.

maria-oncall: Who is the designated caller for backout? I volunteer to be primary today until 23:00 UTC. If I call it, I'll post here and trigger the rollback command, then @eng-oncall will run post-rollback validation.

daniel_rm: Maria — thanks. Primary= @maria-oncall, secondary= @priya.k, release lead — @daniel_rm will authorize only after confirmation from SRE. Communication plan: post here + pages to oncall + update statuspage if user-facing.

priya.k: I'll own the preflight smoke at 21:45 (auth, generate text, embeddings sample). Smoke script: `scripts/smoke/preflight_v2.14.sh` — I'll paste results here. If any critical test fails, we cancel the rollout.

deploybot: :robot_face: preflight job r-4392-preflight started by @priya.k at 21:45 UTC. Logs: `https://logs.internal/r-4392/preflight`

priya.k: Preflight green except one minor warn on metrics-proxy timeout (300ms -> 350ms) — not blocking for canary but we'll watch. Attaching small log snippet:
```
[21:46:12] smoke: auth ok
[21:46:18] smoke: generate_text ok (p50 120ms)
[21:46:25] smoke: embed_sample ok (p50 140ms)
[21:46:27] smoke: metrics-proxy warn (timeout 350ms) — infra ticket created #INC-7821
```

alice-ng: That metrics warning is noted. We keep canary but with tighter SLO triggers: if metrics-proxy p95 > 400ms or 5xx > 1% escalate immediately.

javier.p: Also adding emergency traffic-shift commands here for quick manual rollback of traffic routing (no full rollback):
```
# shift 100% traffic back to stable service version (fast path)
redwoodctl traffic shift --service inference --from canary --to stable --percent 100
```

maria-oncall: OK I'm on pager and will monitor dashboards at canary start. My escalation list: @priya.k (SRE), @alice-ng (Platform), @daniel_rm (Release). If I trigger backout I'll run the rollback command and post summary.

daniel_rm: One more: release notes and user-facing changelog already published to /releases/v2.14.0. Change window reminder to support: 22:00-23:00 UTC. I'll be oncall in case we need to coordinate cross-team.

priya.k: Ready for canary. :thumbsup:

maria-oncall: Starting canary in 10m. Will update here every 5m or earlier on issues.

deploybot: :robot_face: canary started at 22:00 UTC. r-4392-canary (2% traffic)

maria-oncall: 22:05 — dashboard looks OK. p50/p95 stable. No errors above threshold.

priya.k: 22:12 — metrics-proxy p95 creeping to 380ms, p99 still under 420ms, errors 0.6%. Holding.

alice-ng: Holding criteria: leave canary at 2% for another 10m and watch traces. If no regressions, proceed to 25%.

maria-oncall: 22:22 — things look steady. Proceeding to 25% per plan.

deploybot: :robot_face: scaling canary to 25% at 22:24 UTC.

maria-oncall: 22:34 — after 10m at 25% all critical metrics within targets. Proceed to 100% at 22:40.

deploybot: :robot_face: final rollout to 100% started at 22:40 UTC.

maria-oncall: 22:48 — final check OK. No backout triggered. Rolling summary: v2.14.0 fully live. Will leave pin unset so autopromote continues per normal cadence.

daniel_rm: Thanks team. Postmortem: we'll review the metrics-proxy warning in the next retro. Closing this thread when release notes link is attached to the release PR. :tada:
